question: At the 77th Primetime Emmy Awards in 2025, which film won the most awards, taking home eight Emmy Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adolescence**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Adolescence won eight Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Limited or Anthology Series, at the 2025 Emmy Awards.**
 
• **The series was a major winner, with co-creator and star Stephen Graham winning for acting, writing, and producing.**
 
• Owen Cooper, who had never acted professionally before, won Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series.
 
• Adolescence also saw Erin Doherty winning Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adolescence** won eight Emmy Awards, including the prestigious Outstanding Limited or Anthology Series award.
 
• The show also made history with 15-year-old Owen Cooper becoming the youngest-ever male acting winner at the Emmy Awards.
 
• Stephen Graham won three Emmy Awards for acting, writing, and producing the series.
 
• The show gained significant attention for its emotional and impactful storytelling, leading to its success at the awards.
